sources.title: NIST Special Publication 811, Guide to SI, §8.5 Temperature interval and temperature difference
sources.attested: Celsius point uses exact reference 273.15 K while Celsius interval and Kelvin interval have equal numerical magnitude.

sources.title: BIPM SI base unit: kelvin
sources.attested: Kelvin is thermodynamic temperature SI base unit; scale independent of host architecture.

source_boundary: NIST/BIPM attest physical Celsius–Kelvin relation; general exact affine point/delta tag, seven-dimensional descriptor, generic calibrations and provenance are a PROPOSED computational abstraction, not an NIST API.

candidate.domain: universal exact rational quantities with explicit dimension, source and target unit descriptors

argument_schema.quantity: (exact_fraction_value, kind) where kind is POINT or DELTA
argument_schema.source: (seven rational base-exponents, strictly positive rational scale, exact rational origin)
argument_schema.target: (seven rational base-exponents, strictly positive rational scale, exact rational origin)

candidate.law: Reject unless seven dimension exponents match exactly and source/target scale are >0. For POINT, coordinate source base = source_scale*x+source_origin, target result=(source_base-target_origin)/target_scale. For DELTA, source_base=source_scale*x, target result=source_base/target_scale; both origins ignored. Preserve kind, exact rational, and compositional inverse. Errors for invalid kind/dimensions/scale/float, not coercions.

witnesses.explanation: exact scale 5/9 and Fahrenheit origin 45967/180 K

witnesses.input: 4 source calibrated volts, source origin -1/10 baseV, target origin 1/10 baseV
witnesses.explanation: calibration offsets compose in exact rational arithmetic

falsifiers: A 5 °C DELTA converted to 278.15 K confuses a difference with a point.
A 0 °C POINT converted to 0 K loses the exact origin translation.
Converting seconds to metres when seven base dimensions mismatch must reject.
Applying an origin offset to a DELTA violates composition under instrument zero calibration.
Treating floats as exact or allowing zero/negative scale silently invalidates the pure law.
Converting a POINT roundtrip through arbitrary intermediate affine unit must be identity.

holds.name: CIVIL-UTC-AFFINE-CONVERT
holds.reason: UTC leap seconds/discontinuous civil times cannot be represented by one global affine map. No automatic UTC/TAI conversion semantics.

holds.name: LOGARITHMIC-DECIBEL-CONVERT
holds.reason: dB uses a logarithmic ratio with a reference; cannot be treated as a generic affine physical conversion.

holds.name: POINT-PLUS-POINT
holds.reason: Adding two affine points is not generally a valid physical coordinate operation without an origin. Requires separate typed algebra law.

holds.name: ADD-DIMENSION-EXPONENTS
holds.reason: D10 existing SCIENCE-MERGE-DIMENSIONS and SCIENCE-ADD-DIMENSION already operate on dimension exponents.

limitations: No canonical D10 selected inventory, transition history, D1–D9, D2, T5, language opcodes or hardware emission changed.
A Python exact-rational oracle and SBCL donor check prove only this formal model; not SENS interpreter execution.
The SI defining constants are existing world definitions, not invented D10 semantic slots.
